openrouter.messages.name: openrouter.messages
openrouter.messages._comment_max_tokens: Same limit as aiprime.messages so both profiles are compared under equal conditions.
openrouter.messages._comment_models: classify = cheapest model passing spec 9 on tests/golden (prompt ai_value-v2, 2026-09-25: 91.7%, $0.10/run; see tests/golden/RESULTS.md).
openrouter.messages._comment_price_table: From the OpenRouter /models listing on 2026-09-25; the chat_completions probe reported usage.cost matching it (14 in + 4 out = $0.000068). The messages endpoint returns no cost field.
openrouter.messages._comment_input_overhead: Probe 2026-09-25: 'reply with ok' = 14 input tokens, no hidden overhead.

openrouter.chat_completions.name: openrouter.chat_completions
openrouter.chat_completions._comment_cost_source: Probe 2026-09-25: usage.cost is returned on chat/completions.

openai.chat_completions.name: openai.chat_completions
openai.chat_completions._comment_price_table: From the OpenRouter /models listing for openai/gpt-6-* on 2026-09-25; verify against the OpenAI billing export before relying on it.
openai.chat_completions._comment_model_params: Probe 2026-09-25: GPT-6 accepts only the default temperature; function tools on /chat/completions need reasoning_effort=none, which astra does not support (low/medium/high/xhigh only), so astra runs in text mode.
